description: Search and retrieve the complete author-verified public Cassie Hour lyrics. Omit query or pass an empty string to retrieve the full public lyric record; a nonempty query filters by substring across title, creator and lyric text. Returns source IDs, content hash, supplied language/section/stanza information and official listening links. Anonymous access is allowed. This does not expose raw audio or grant manuscript access; if no substring match is found, results are empty rather than synthesized.

idempotency_key.description: This optional field is present in the shared music-tool schema but is not read by this operation; omit it.

query.description: Optional substring filter, up to 500 characters, searched in the title, creator and lyric text. Omit or use an empty string to retrieve the complete public lyric record.

receipt_id.description: This optional field is present in the shared music-tool schema but is not read by this operation; omit it.

name: search_lyrics
title: search lyrics
